payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: 10 pre-existing task-status-cycler unit failures reproduce identically on the clean base (bob-plugins HEAD 5ed3bd22, verified in a detached worktree): test-task-status-cycler-open-line.cjs "creating a notes drawer before a work-log origin shifts origin by two", plus 9 req failures in test-task-status-cycler-req-toggle.cjs and test-task-status-cycler-task-reqs-vectors.cjs (NOTES drawer landing, missing-final-newline, CRLF tidy). Unrelated to the pure-twin change (cycler bundle byte-identical).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-plugins npm run docs:check lint fails on word budgets in files untouched by this phase (docs/develop/plugins/plugin-apis.md 9287 words vs 8000 cap; docs/reference/plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys.md 6068 vs 6000 cap). Pre-existing; needs a docs-budget pass.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: test-ledger-tools-frees-marks.cjs "200-link / 2000-task build stays within the 25 ms budget" failed once in the full-suite run but passes in isolation on both base and current trees; treat as load flake, consider raising the budget or isolating the perf file.

pure-twin done: 4 new ledger-tools fragments (139a model/classification/eligibility, 139b grouping parser, 139c grouping emitter, 139d settle+Myers line-map) with test exports in 351-exports-task-settle. All 18 canonical settle vectors pass through the built bundle (bytes, changed, line maps, warnings, second-pass no-op); Rust settle_vectors + 61 task_status_groups tests pass. Fixture dir copied byte-identical with update-bob-cli-first README note; 3 new test files registered and passing (10/10); manifest bumped 1.157.1->1.158.0, build:check and docs inventory green, deployed via bob plugins sync -p. No v1 namespace published. 10 cycler + docs-lint + 1 perf-flake failures recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (reproduce on clean base).
